 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 participant C as Client
 participant F as FastAPI
 participant V as Validator
 participant J as JWKSCache
 participant A as Authentik

 C->>F: GET /api/me + Bearer JWT
 F->>V: validate(token)
 V->>J: get_key_with_refresh(kid)
 alt Cache has the key
 J-->>V: JWK
 else Key missing
 J->>A: GET /jwks/
 A-->>J: JWKS document
 J-->>V: JWK
 end
 V->>V: verify signature + iss + aud + exp
 alt Token is valid
 V-->>F: claims
 F-->>C: 200 OK + claims
 else Token is invalid
 V-->>F: HTTPException 401
 F-->>C: 401 + WWW-Authenticate: Bearer
 end",
 "config": null
